messages.text: The $799 on the page is the price for the H15 Dual, and there's no 11.11 code. For that you get one machine that mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin from your desk, and you own it outright. What do you pay for electricity?

The B30 has no code either. It's $899, the price on the page. You get 30 TH/s of Bitcoin hashing in Turbo mode, or you can drop it to quieter, lower-power modes. That's about twice the Bitcoin hashing of the H15 Dual.

If you want both machines, the Harlo Duo Pack (B30 + H15 Dual) is listed at $1,599. Buying them separately would cost $1,698.

What do you pay for power per kWh? With that I can show you what the B30 would stack each month and what it would cost to run.
